E-Mu Proteus FX

https://freewavesamples.com/source/e-mu-proteus-fx

The Proteus FX is a rompler module that combines the sounds of the Proteus 1, 2, 3, and the Proformance piano module into the same hardware and then adds an effects processor.


Ensoniq SD-1

https://freewavesamples.com/source/ensoniq-sd-1

The Ensoniq SD-1 is a rompler from 1990 with the ability to create patches combining up to six sounds. It is an upgraded version of the <a href="/source/ensoniq-vfx">Ensoniq VFX-SD</a> with more piano sounds and sounds very similar.
